home.title: AuraLearn
home.subtitle: Your Child's Personal Learning Coach
home.description: Every child learns differently. AuraLearn understands your child's unique learning style and provides personalized guidance, activities, and support strategies—so you can help them thrive at home and in school.
home.heroDescription: The AI-powered platform that helps parents and teachers understand how each child learns, so every student can reach their full potential.

forParents.title: For Parents
forParents.subtitle: Support Your Child's Learning Journey
forParents.description: Finally understand how your child learns best. Get personalized strategies, daily activities, and expert guidance tailored to your child's unique learning style—all in one place.
benefits: Discover your child's learning strengths and needs
Get personalized support strategies you can use at home
Access daily activities that match how your child learns
Track progress and celebrate growth together

forTeachers.title: For Teachers
forTeachers.subtitle: Personalize Learning for Every Student
forTeachers.description: Understand how each student learns and get AI-powered teaching strategies that adapt to their needs. Create differentiated instruction that helps every child succeed.
benefits: Identify each student's unique learning profile
Track student progress and adjust instruction

forStudents.title: How Students Benefit
forStudents.subtitle: Learning That Fits How They Learn
forStudents.description: When parents and teachers understand how a child learns, magic happens. Students get the support they need, when they need it, in ways that work for them.
benefits: Learn in ways that match their natural strengths
Get support that's tailored to their needs
Thrive both at home and in the classroom

cognitiveAssessment.title: Cognitive Assessments
cognitiveAssessment.description: Share cognitive assessment links with students and parents - 15 questions across 6 validated cognitive domains

banner.title: Research-Backed Cognitive Assessment
banner.description: 15 questions across 6 validated domains: Processing Speed, Working Memory, Attention & Focus, Learning Style, Self-Efficacy, and Motivation. Based on MSLQ, BRIEF-2, WISC-V, and UDL principles.
banner.triangulation: Triangulation: Students complete self-assessment, parents complete observation assessment, and results are triangulated to identify discrepancies and gain deeper insights.
